Declares: `Expectation`, `Tester`, `Tests`

```luau
--- Represents an expectation used within a test case. Each method performs an
--- assertion comparing the supplied value to the expected one.
export type Expectation = {

    --- Asserts that the value equals the expected value.
    --- ```lua
    --- expect(5).is(5)
    --- expect("hello").is("hello")
    --- ```
	is: (any) -> (),

    --- Asserts that the value is greater than the expected value.
    --- ```lua
    --- expect(10).greaterThan(5)
    --- ```
	greaterThan: (any) -> (),

    --- Asserts that the value is less than the expected value.
    --- ```lua
    --- expect(3).lessThan(10)
    --- ```
	lessThan: (any) -> (),

    --- Asserts that the value is greater than or equal to the expected value.
    --- ```lua
    --- expect(5).greaterThanOrEqual(5)
    --- expect(6).greaterThanOrEqual(5)
    --- ```
	greaterThanOrEqual: (any) -> (),

    --- Asserts that the value is less than or equal to the expected value.
    --- ```lua
    --- expect(5).lessThanOrEqual(5)
    --- expect(4).lessThanOrEqual(5)
    --- ```
	lessThanOrEqual: (any) -> (),

    --- Returns an `Expectation` that negates the subsequent assertion.
    --- ```lua
    --- expect(5).never.is(3)
    --- expect(5).never.greaterThan(10)
    --- ```
	read never: Expectation,
}

--- Provides functions for defining test cases and organizing them into groups.
export type Tester = {

    --- Defines a named test case. The callback receives an `expect` function
    --- used to create expectations on a value.
    --- ```lua
    --- case("adds two numbers", function(expect)
    ---   local result = 2 + 3
    ---   expect(result).is(5)
    --- end)
    --- ```
	case: (name: string, test: (expect: (value: any) -> Expectation) -> ()) -> (),

    --- Groups related test cases under a common name. Nested groups are supported.
    --- ```lua
    --- group("Math utilities", function()
    ---   case("adds numbers", function(expect)
    ---     expect(2 + 2).is(4)
    ---   end)
    ---
    ---   case("multiplies numbers", function(expect)
    ---     expect(3 * 4).is(12)
    ---   end)
    --- end)
    --- ```
	group: (name: string, test: () -> ()) -> (),

    --- Looks up a blob asset in the file by name, or nil when missing.
    --- ```lua
    --- local data = test.blob("fixtures")
    --- ```
	blob: (name: string) -> Blob?,
}

--- A function that defines a collection of test cases. The `Tester` is provided
--- to allow cases and groups to be declared.
---
--- See Unit Testing for usage.
export type Tests = (test: Tester) -> ()
```
